actions.rebootText: Restarts the whole device. The screen stays dark for about a minute.
actions.regenHint: Runs until you stop it here or in the administration, or until the player or the device restarts.
actions.regenText: Shows full-screen white noise instead of the content. This evens out burn-in on plasma screens; let it run for a few hours, e.g. outside opening hours.
actions.restartText: Restarts the player browser. The content continues after a few seconds.
app.subtitle: Client
display.customHint: Forces a mode the screen does not report. If it fails, the previous mode is restored.
display.failed: The mode could not be applied: {error}
display.notAvailable: Display control is not available on this device.
error.csrf: The form has expired. Please reload the page and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
flash.regenerationOff: Plasma regeneration stopped. The content continues.
flash.regenerationOn: Plasma regeneration started. The screen shows white noise.
flash.repaired: Pairing reset. A new PIN is shown on the screen.
flash.serverSaved: Server address saved. The device connects to it.
flash.updateStarted: Update started. The device restarts when the installation is complete.
lang.label: Language
login.defaultHint: First sign-in: the password is "{password}". You will then choose your own.
login.locked: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a moment.
login.throttled: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
notice.fingerprint_mismatch: Server identity does not match – pairing refused.
notice.pairing_refused: The server refused the pairing request.
notice.versionMismatch: Version does not match the server – please update in the administration.
pairing.pinHint: Enter this PIN in the admin WebGUI under Devices to take over this device.
pairing.repairText: Deletes all content and the connection of the current server and shows a new PIN. Display settings are kept.
pairing.resetText: Also deletes the display settings, the server address and the password (back to the default password).
password.central: The password is managed centrally by the server and cannot be changed here.
password.forced: Please choose your own password before you continue.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
password.notDefault: Please do not use the default password.
password.tooShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.
server.addressHint: IP address or host name, optionally with :port (default 7443), e.g. a Tailscale IP.
server.warning: A paired device keeps its pairing and content when the same server is reached at the new address (e.g. a VPN or a new IP). To switch to a different server, use “Pair again”.
status.certChangedHint: The server certificate has changed. If this is expected, pair the device again.
syncError.manifest_fetch_failed: Content list could not be loaded
update.fallbackText: If the server cannot provide the package for this device, the device can download exactly the server version {version} from the GitHub release of {repo}. The package is checked against the release signature.
update.hint: Updates are installed from the admin WebGUI of the server; the device then fetches the package from the server.
update.phase.rolled_back: Rolled back to the previous version
